answer: Pay for consumption, not for supply. Each epoch a sortition panel of long-tenured accounts issues a fixed quota of work orders, each prepaid from an escrow fee, and no seat may issue twice. A clone farm can mint unlimited laborers but not demand: order rights are non-transferable and gated on tenure, so surplus identities sit idle and earn nothing. Rewards vest only once a requester's downstream output is actually used. The delta an attacker must fund is customers, not keys, paid in real fees from outside capital. A tundra of idle clones earns zero; the mesa of paying demand stays scarce.
